status: Not authority. A measurement over stored records; no session, no dossier run, no provider call.

inputRoots.run-*: the operator's dossier state directory (default ~/.local/state/syzygy-dossier); run-*.agents and run-*.sessions never opened or listed

fixedInputCohort.caveat: the cohort's runs span several brief versions and draft schemas, so (a) and (b) mix author variance with the mechanism changing

a_author_variance.label: Observed

predicates.block: any dict under introduction, sections, diagrams, deepDives or unresolved with a non-empty citations list whose items carry a path (the understanding record is excluded)
predicates.citedLines: the set of (path, line) over a block's citations, each closed range startLine..endLine
predicates.loose: block X of run A is matched in run B when some block of B shares a cited (path, line) with X
predicates.strict: block X of run A is matched in run B when some block of B has cited-line Jaccard >= 0.5 with X; a block with no line citation is never matched
predicates.words: lowercased regex [a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,}, minus {the,and,for,how,what,with,its,are,from,that,this,into} and the words of the repository id
predicates.thesis: understanding.proposition: its statements' words and its cited lines
predicates.pairs: mean over unordered run pairs (Jaccard) or ordered pairs (share matched); a pair of two empty sets is left out

a_author_variance.denominator: 6 runs at one repository and commit; blocks per run in runs[*].blocks

b_pooled_ceiling.label: Observed (counts); Inferred (that the union stands in for a depth ceiling)

predicates.supportedClaim: a block of the draft inside the packet of the run's last fidelity verdict whose blockSupport verdict is 'supported' and which cites at least one line
predicates.sameClaim: items of different runs join one cluster (union-find, transitive) when their cited (path, line) sets have Jaccard >= the threshold; 'any' joins on one shared line; items of one run never join directly
predicates.sameEntry: inventory entries (each run's last inventory revision) join when kinds are equal and cited (path, line) sets meet the threshold; an entry with no line citation is its own cluster
predicates.share: clusters holding at least one item of the run / all clusters
predicates.secondRunGain: clustering A and B together: clusters with no item of A / clusters with an item of A; the R28 rule builds two-author mode only if a fresh second run at the same brief adds at least 0.25

b_pooled_ceiling.denominator: 6 runs at one repository and commit; union cluster counts per threshold stated

e_reviewer_consistency.label: Observed

predicates.pair: consecutive verdict files N and N+1 of one kind in one run with equal packetSha256
predicates.findingSet: set of (severity, subject, target or page); Jaccard between the two verdicts
predicates.agreement: share of block ids (entry ids) in both verdicts with equal blockSupport verdict (coverage disposition)
predicates.reviewCheckOutcome: the steps.jsonl review-check row of that kind whose number equals the verdict's number

e_reviewer_consistency.denominator: consecutiveVerdictPairsExamined, over every run and both review kinds

e_comprehension_instrument_noise.label: Observed (spreads and differences); Inferred (the sampling error, which treats facts as independent draws)

predicates.share: sum of fact grades (0, 0.5, 1) / required facts, overall or over one kind's questions
predicates.spreadPoints: (max - min) * 100 over the listed gradings of one arm's unchanged answers
predicates.readerRepeat: two reader sessions given the same stored run's site, graded in the same (fourth) grading
predicates.sameTextEveryMeasurement: every grading of the kept arm plus the new reader's grading: reader and grader together
predicates.factLevel: facts given an equal grade in two gradings (or by two readers), over all required facts
predicates.samplingError: 100 * sqrt(p (1 - p) / n), n the facts in the share

e_comprehension_instrument_noise.denominator: 81 required facts over 24 questions; gradings first to fourth; arms graded at least twice with unchanged answers, and two reader pairs
e_comprehension_instrument_noise.caveat: That arms D, E and P in the fourth grading are the pilot's stored answers, and that Y and Z read the same text as D and E, rests on the reader record's README; the record stores no fourth grading input

f_stage_time_and_operator_actions.label: Observed (times, records); Inferred (the operator-action total is a floor: preflight, clone agreement, init, the run-configuration answer and any consent step leave no step record)

predicates.round: a steps.jsonl session-prompt row with role review and outcome delivered; it ends at the next review-check row of the same kind with outcome validated; refused review-check rows between are counted
predicates.wall: last step row's at minus the first's
predicates.authorMinutesToFirstCheck: first check row's at minus the first step row's
predicates.sessionsStarted: distinct (role, kind, session) over await rows: each is a terminal the operator started
predicates.launchFormRecords: names of inventory/*.launch.json and reviews/*.launch.json (listed, never read)
predicates.clarificationsAnswered: length of clarifications in the last draft revision
predicates.usageFiguresGivenAtClose: the close row carries a usage other than null, 'not-recorded' or {}

f_stage_time_and_operator_actions.denominator: 7 runs; rounds counted per kind in reviewRounds
